answer:
You don't need a separate flag. You pass the registry URI as the positional path argument to `scan-model`, and set environment variables for the server and credentials.

**MLflow:** Pass a `models:/` URI and point `MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI` at your tracking server:

- "promptfoo scan-model models:/MyModel/Latest" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]
- "`MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI`: The URI of your MLflow tracking server." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

```bash
export MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI="https://your-mlflow-server.com"
export MLFLOW_TRACKING_USERNAME="your-username"
export MLFLOW_TRACKING_PASSWORD="your-password"
promptfoo scan-model models:/model-name/version
```

**JFrog Artifactory:** Pass the full artifact URL as the path, and set the base URL and token as environment variables:

- "promptfoo scan-model "https://your-domain.jfrog.io/artifactory/models/model.pkl"" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]
- "`JFROG_URL`: The base URL of your JFrog Artifactory instance." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]
- "`JFROG_API_TOKEN` or `JFROG_ACCESS_TOKEN`: Your API or access token." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

```bash
export JFROG_URL="https://your-domain.jfrog.io"
export JFROG_API_TOKEN="your-api-token"
promptfoo scan-model "https://your-domain.jfrog.io/artifactory/repo/model.pkl"
```

The provided docs don't show a dedicated option for selecting a registry, so I don't know whether one exists. For MLflow, the `models:/` path is the registry reference, and for JFrog it's the artifact URL.
